input.quote: This Agreement shall commence on the Effective Date and, unless terminated earlier pursuant to this Article 13, shall continue in full force and effect, on a Product-by-Product and country-by-country basis until the Secondary Royalty Term with respect to such Product expires, at which time this Agreement shall expire in its entirety with respect to such Product in such country.
input.rationale: The Agreement has no evergreen or automatic-renewal mechanic. Section 13.1 (p0627) sets a self-executing term that runs Product-by-Product and country-by-country until expiry of the Secondary Royalty Term (defined at p0121 by reference to the Initial Royalty Term), and on expiry Ono's Section 2.1 licences convert to non-exclusive, fully paid-up, irrevocable, perpetual, royalty-free licences with sublicensing rights — an outcome that favours us. Searches for "renew", "automatically renew", extension/successive-term and renewal price-uplift language return no auto-renewal clause; Section 14.4 (p0672) confirms that post-expiry dealings "shall not be construed as a renewal or extension hereof." Because renewal is not automatic, every conditional preferred element (12-month renewal term, 30-day opt-out, 60-day Vendor reminder, CPI/3% uplift cap) is inapplicable, and any extension of the term would require a mutually agreed written amendment. The clause therefore meets the preferred position by structure; there is no non-renewal notice window to shorten and no renewal price-increase mechanic to cap, so no redline is warranted.
